messages:
anja: Pushed docs PR for the incident notes / known-issues backfill. Adds a small workaround section and a statuspage link. Need a reviewer + merge window before the next deploy.

mike: Thanks — sending a quick review now. Is this only for the status anchor or also updating the SDK snippet?

anja: Both. Updated the Ruby and JS snippets to reflect the fallback model policy. JS example is tiny:```js
const r = await client.generate({ model: 'redwood/default:1.2', prompt: '...' })
// if code path fails, fall back to smaller model
```

sophie: Noted. I'll check the examples. Also FYI linkcheck failed locally for the status url (404) — CI will catch it too.

docs-bot: docs-ci preview started: https://docs-preview.internal/pr/5123 (status: building) :hourglass_flowing_sand:

raj: @anja can you add a short sentence recommending the retry backoff (500ms -> 2s) for requests that hit the degraded backend? Ops asked for it in the incident notes.

anja: Good call — adding the backoff section now.

mike: Quick review done, left two tiny nits (formatting of code block and an extra trailing whitespace). Approving after those.

docs-bot: docs-ci preview update: linkcheck error on /known-issues.incident-1420 -> returns 404. Full log: "Broken link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1420"

anja: Hm. Status page permalink changed after the incident. I'll update with the canonical anchor `#1420-root-cause` and push.

taylor: Heads up: we have a deploy window at 03:15 UTC. If the docs PR isn't merged before then the release will contain the stale notes. Do we want to gate the deploy?

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy in 45m (03:15 UTC). Rolling release: infra->api->docs.

sophie: We should merge docs first, then abort docs portion of the deploy if preview still failing. I can be on standby to rollback docs if something glitched.

anja: Updated link and added the retry backoff snippet. Pushed. New preview: https://docs-preview.internal/pr/5123/changes

docs-bot: docs-ci preview passed (build: 5123). Linkcheck: OK. Rendering: OK. :white_check_mark:

mike: Merged the PR — used the emergency merge window (docs-only).

taylor: Thanks — I'll let deploy proceed. If we see any leftover stale references on the status page, I'll open a follow-up.

anja: Thanks everyone. I'll also add an internal changelog entry and ping customer-success to surface the workaround in the post-incident email.

raj: Appreciate the quick turn. Leaving a note in the incident thread with the exact snippet and link.

mike: small follow-up: we should add a test in our docs CI to validate the status page anchor pattern so this doesn't slip again. Filed https://issues.redwood.ai/issue/8840

anja: Filed a docs task to add that test. Closing this thread when deploy is green. :white_check_mark:
